name: Grilled corn
summary: Bắp nướng is corn grilled over charcoal at the tree stalls under Silver Waterfall.
origin: Sa Pa, at the Silver Waterfall stalls.
howToEat: Eat it on the cob with the other stall snacks after the falls walk.
where: The tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward Ô Quy Hồ.
seoTitle: Grilled corn in Sapa — Silver Waterfall stalls
seoDescription: Bắp nướng under the trees at Silver Waterfall, with cơm lam, eggs, and sweet potato.
